_doc: Room recipes, by room key (dune-run --rooms). parts: people and objects painted into the room, redone in close-up (box in low-res pixels).

defaults.negative: out of focus, depth of field, bokeh, blurry, soft focus, haze, cartoon, anime, painting, illustration, drawing, pixel art, cgi, 3d render, deformed, text, watermark, frame, noise

859cf422c2ae871b.title: Palace throne room
859cf422c2ae871b.prompt: cinematic photograph of the interior of a grand ducal throne room, deep focus, everything in sharp focus, a massive carved bronze throne on a round dais, tall fluted copper columns, a mounted bull's head trophy above the throne, green heraldic banners, red hawk emblems, two ornate doors, on each side a guard in a grey-blue armoured uniform and helmet standing at attention holding a long rifle, polished marble floor, warm light, highly detailed

parts.prompt: cinematic photograph, full body of a palace guard standing at attention, grey-blue armoured military uniform with shoulder plates and chest armour, round steel helmet, holding a long rifle diagonally across his body with both hands, armoured greaves, black boots, in a throne room, sharp focus, highly detailed
